_comment: The Wheel. Six spokes, three rings each, and a centre that only opens when every spoke has moved. Rewards stay small and capped — the Wheel is identity, not power.

axes.name: Move
axes.desc: Everything you did with your body.

axes.name: Rest
axes.desc: The half of training nobody posts about.

axes.name: Bond
axes.desc: The axis everyone forgets is a health axis.

centre.name: Balance
centre.desc: Every spoke off the mark. The loop cannot hold someone who is looking after all of it.

special.name: Persistent
special.desc: Survive ten loop resets and keep going.

special.name: Wayfarer
special.desc: Walk out to the third ring.

special.name: Witness
special.desc: Stand in front of the Warden.
